equations.title: arithmetic E8 trace form
equations.assumptions: K=Q(zeta_30), G=B^T A B in the supplied unimodular Krylov basis; Norm(alpha)=1/1265625 and det(G)=1. The cyclotomic realization is classical; explicit source-coordinate identity, no priority claim.

equations.title: integral Coxeter commutant
equations.assumptions: The supplied cyclic vector has an integral Krylov basis; a commuting map is multiplication by its value at 1. This concerns integral linear endomorphisms, not all Lie endomorphisms.

equations.title: Coxeter isometry centralizer
equations.assumptions: Use the specified trace form, trace nondegeneracy and Kronecker; alternatively exhaustive root-image replay. The centralizer theorem is classical, not newly discovered here.

equations.title: semilinear arithmetic isometry
equations.equation: S_a(x)=u_a*sigma_a(x) is an isometry iff alpha*u_a*conjugate(u_a)=sigma_a(alpha)
equations.assumptions: a is a unit modulo 30 and sigma_a(zeta)=zeta^a; S_a must also preserve the integral lattice to be an integral isometry. The norm ratio is sigma_a(alpha)/alpha.

equations.title: complete Coxeter normalizer by cyclic root images
equations.assumptions: Enumerate all eight unit exponents and all 240 actual roots; exactly 30 lifts per exponent. Completeness follows from the cyclic basis. There are two root orbits of size 120; the group is not identified with the roots by cardinality.

equations.title: nonsplit arithmetic normalizer extension
equations.assumptions: S(x)=(zeta^2+zeta^3+zeta^4+zeta^5-zeta^7)*sigma_7(x). Every lift of the quotient element 7 has nonidentity fourth power, so 1->C30->N->(Z/30)^*->1 has no section. No historical novelty claim.

equations.title: Raghava moments as positive power moments
equations.assumptions: Principal phases 0<=q<1 and nonnegative weights; mu_0=r_0 is mass. Positivity is essential for global finite uniqueness; this identifies a folded spectral measure.

equations.title: exact Hankel annihilator reconstruction
equations.assumptions: H_ij=mu_(i+j); s distinct positive-mass folded atoms make H_(s-1) positive definite. p(X)=X^s+sum_(j<s)p_j X^j. This step uses 2s coordinates and a declared atom count.

equations.title: conductor-independent finite positive uniqueness
equations.equation: sum_q w_q*p(x_q)^2=0 => support(mu) subset roots(p); mu_0..mu_(2s) determine the positive s-atom profile
equations.assumptions: The extra moment mu_(2s) proves support containment for every nonnegative finite competitor, without a competitor conductor or support-size bound; Vandermonde then fixes weights. Signed measures are excluded.

equations.title: all later Raghava moments from a finite annihilator
equations.assumptions: p vanishes on the recovered folded support. The identity determines all subsequent even moment coordinates; it does not recover the integral lattice or Lie bracket.

equations.title: finite E8 folded spectral certificate
equations.equation: E8: x={1,4,16,49}/225, each weight 2; mass and r_1..r_8 certify this folded profile
equations.assumptions: Nine coordinates including mass uniquely determine the folded reflection spectrum among all nonnegative finite phase profiles. Four further odd Mellin observations suffice to orient it.

equations.title: sharp eight-coordinate positive rational collision
equations.assumptions: Use the nine interlaced nodes 0,1/225,1/100,4/225,1/25,16/225,1/9,49/225,1/4 and weights 2*1_(i odd)+epsilon*delta_i, epsilon=14144/3243658447265625. All weights are positive, phases have conductor dividing 30, and r_0..r_7 match E8. Minimality among dimension-eight integer representations is not proved.

equations.title: oriented recovery by absolutely convergent odd Mellin traces
equations.assumptions: k>=1; y_k is Im(sum_n Tr(T^n)/n^(2k+1))/pi^(2k+1). For s* interior folded nodes, s* rows invert a scaled Vandermonde system and recover orientation. Reflection: 9 even+4 odd sufficient; adjoint:33 even+14 odd. No minimum claim for the combined scheme.
